photos.place: Saravan, Sistan and Baluchestan Province, Iran

paras: Rhinogekko femoralis, also known as the sharp-tailed spider gecko or Kharan spider gecko, is a species of gecko found in Pakistan and Iran. The IUCN Redlist considers its presence in Iran uncertain. It measures 52–60 mm (2.0–2.4 in) in snout–vent length.
